content: restic --exclude uses Go filepath.Match syntax plus ** for directory levels; patterns are tested against the full path (bare names match at any depth via the bare-name rule); excluded directories are pruned from the walk and their contents cannot be re-included. DECISIVE: excludes do NOT apply to backup sources explicitly passed as positional arguments - only to content below them - so parent+exclude compilation must never coexist with the excluded child as a positional source.
